primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: BMI was calculated as weight (kg)/height (m\^2). Least square (LS) mean and standard error (SE) were calculated using analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) model.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: mITT analysis set included all randomized participants who were exposed to at least 1 dose of study treatment. Participants in pivotal cohort were included in the analysis.
